contract: Track node container allocation count, element container allocation count and allocation arity independently of logical object counts and selected arity.
For each positive-count container, resize direct buffers by linear prefix preservation and invoke registered descriptor allocation without clearing previous storage.
A nonpositive-count container is a complete no-op, including no reads from the component table.
Refresh does not reapply node8, element44 or direct61 replacement defaults, and does not rebuild boundaries.
Descriptor storage preserves existing entries and zero-fills appended entries. MATAXI diagonal initialization follows its existing total-size-change/width9 policy.
Direct buffers retain initialized-prefix metadata. Shrinking clamps that prefix; growing does not extend it. New tail placeholders are explicitly not original values.
The new replay serializes unspecified direct-buffer entries as null rather than exposing backing zeros as recovered data.
All extents for both active containers are checked before mutation. Allocation failure during mutation is not transactional and is outside verified equivalence.

evidence.candidate_history: Source, library and executable archived before both original captures. No C++ candidate changes followed either capture.
evidence.discovery_limitation: The first probe did not hook initial replacement allocations, leaving first direct-before extents unknown. Its template and capture remain unchanged.

evaluation.inputs: Each object keeps one replay instance. Captured BEFORE values seed descriptors and known direct prefixes; AFTER observations never seed the candidate.
evaluation.comparison: Compare continuing shape/history, allocation metadata, boundaries, all53 descriptors and known direct prefixes. Known binary64 values are decoded from raw hex and compared bitwise, including signed zero.
evaluation.unknown_values: Native grown-tail bytes are retained as observations, not expected zeros. The independent verifier compares min(old,new) raw bytes even when that prefix includes earlier unspecified bytes; replacement validity remains conservative.
evaluation.coverage: One populated2D mesh, an inactive placeholder and an empty active object. GEOTYP1/3 and STNOUT combinations cause growth, shrink and repeated refresh before scientific finalization.

limitations: This evaluates storage refresh, not replacement prediction of every BEFORE value or GEOTYP/STNOUT parsing.
Raw mutable spans still expose backing storage. Downstream consumers must honor initialized-prefix metadata; writes through spans cannot yet promote validity.
The fixture keeps logical/container counts and arity unchanged during refresh. Separate metadata is supported by static evidence, but divergence and arbitrary direct count changes remain untested.
Private descriptor storage and unit multiplicities only; sharing/detachment, nonunit multiplicities and allocation failures remain unresolved.
Runtime does not cover every descriptor policy branch, including a newly activated9-wide MATAXI field.
The complete capture repeats the discovery fixture after probe repair. It is not a wholly unseen held-out input.
Scientific finalization and complete model/importer integration remain required.
next: Integrate configuration scalar state and feature-query results with the selected importer, using configuration-refresh-contract.json; make all output and downstream reads respect unknown direct-buffer tails.
